clues: This city in India is famed for its palace, its fort, and its temples. All stand in the stark lands of a great desert.
Heat here is fierce from March to October and tops forty degrees in late spring. Then monsoon clouds roll in and bring a slight break.
It was founded in 1459 by a clan chief of the Rajput folk. For long years it ruled as the seat of a desert kingdom.
In the old town, most homes are painted a bright and vivid blue. Guests who see those blue lanes once tend to recall them for years.
The old town wraps in a ring around a great fort. A strong wall with gates bounds the lanes of the old town.
